scientific_integrity: Exact coefficient identities and a differential-equation proof establish the all-prime result; a finite set of formal-polynomial and point-count tests is corroborative, not a substitute for proof. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Algebraically closed characteristic p=6m+1 prime only; geometric marked isomorphism classes only, not finite-field rationality. Does not determine full zeta functions. Related characteristic-seven case and broad Shimura superspecial counts are known and not claimed independently. General identification with all Shimura coarse points is not asserted.
title: A squarefree Hasse polynomial for bielliptic Picard Pryms in split characteristics
